snapshots.subject: external full-scope review of pre-0.0.43 release tip b3418ac

findings.summary: Uninstall find-chown lacks symlink exclusion; agent-planted link makes root-run revert chown arbitrary outside target.
Docroot gates lexical only; intermediate symlink component passes; root chown -R hands outside tree to agent group.
Migrate suite rm -rf includes fixed host paths /var/www/vhosts/alpha and /sub; deletes real projects on contributor machines.
CI never runs test-tui-mode.sh (passed as argument); workflow guard counts argument tokens as coverage.
Migrate resume matches dumps by ddev name only, ignores stored approot; moved project imports unrelated dump.
Uninstall setfacl -R -b/-k wipes all pre-existing ACLs; install getfacl backup never offered for restore.
Both install.conf rewrites stage through fixed sibling install.conf.opk-new without lock; concurrent opk config clobbers.
setup-container-backend header promises teardown on backend switch; dispatch only provisions, old backend keeps running.
--projects values iterate unquoted; glob metacharacters unrejected, expand inside the installer.
make test omits test-deploy-lib, test-secure-binary, test-sudoers-deploy; local gate weaker than CI.
check-version glob accepts non-digit tails (1x.2y.3z); not a strict semver check.
SHELLCHECK_FILES omits seven shipped scripts incl. bin/xdg-open; comment claims full coverage; no guard.
Design record: ddev<1.25 advisory, --yes provisions nothing; code hard-exits and defaults to docker-rootless.
files.md and wsl-conf-consent.md omit 2.x<2.0.18 bridge range; users in that range hit login failures.
audit-log.md promises all system-changing scripts log; dispatcher carrier write and handover path unlogged.
files.md 'every managed file' omits per-user TUI assets, danger theme, 2.x plugin registration.
Design record says .git stays developer-owned 700; baseline grants group access (issue #17).
CONTRIBUTING calls master the live install source; default install source is the stable mirror.
Design records show removed CLI name opencode-permissions-kit as live command; dispatcher is opk.
Carrier success message names only the 1.x range; same command serves 2.x below 2.0.18.
Help synopsis omits implemented, documented uninstall --debug.
CONTRIBUTING hard-codes feature/simplify-script-calls as the branch example.
Test scripts reference removed workflow chmod lists in present tense; extends the 0.0.42d D1 family.
check-host.sh optional-tools note names two e2e suites; e2e-ddev is a third.
Whitespace-tolerance test asserts false out-of-range; passes even when whitespace parsing broken; needs true-case.
Claim: install/update silently rewrite /etc/wsl.conf violating consent rule; verification found documented sanctioned carve-out.
Self-retracted suspicion: recursive chown traverses themes symlink into /etc; coreutils does not follow final symlink.

process_notes: Same tree as snapshot -d; second independent snapshot per release cadence; the union of -d and -e drives the fix wave.

stated_counts are the external Luna report's (26 findings: 2/7/14/3) as quoted in the header; post-verification loop status states 2 HIGH + 6 MED (Luna S3 retracted, later un-retracted as LOW carve-out in the resolution).
Incident: Luna's host make test executed C1's rm -rf cleanup (paths absent, pre-run state unknowable); e2e deliberately not re-run after discovery; no-op on this host.
25 of 26 external findings confirmed (two with severity-lean notes: C3 lean LOW, C5 lean LOW); cross-snapshot calibration table lists -d/-e overlaps and unique catches.
Unverified leads recorded but not promoted: TUI parent-chain guard, project-root symlinked ancestors, subuid check-then-append race.

snapshots.subject: full-scope review of the 0.0.43 release tip (PR #139 merge)

findings.summary: Severity vocabulary rejects GitHub 'medium'; advisory skipped, watch dies red, no tracking issue opened.
Empty TSV fields collapse under tab-IFS read; unpatched advisories shift columns, skipped, scan dies.
Unbounded --version probe in OPENCODE_MAJOR fallback hangs every opencode invocation; violates fail-open rule.
Unguarded cd SERVE_FALLBACK under set -e aborts opencode serve before exec when developer lacks traversal.
Pre-0.0.10 legacy artifacts survive uninstall; active sudoers grant left; 'Uninstall complete' still printed.
Spaced home paths split unquoted in three ddev-migrate helpers; directory emitted as the ddev binary.
Null severity raises TypeError in join; whole scan dies with misleading parse-failure error.
Empty projects.conf: grep -c rc-1 path appends a second 0; Projects header broken across lines.
Post-copy verification failure prints false 'untouched' message and deletes the recovery backup.
fs-baseline pass failures never propagate; callers print 'applied' regardless of wholesale failure.
Bridge rewrite eats one foreign blank line when end marker destroyed; contradicts stated invariant.
Hardcoded /home/<user> instead of getent-resolved home in ddev-hosts and ddev-migrate.
jsonc-parser crashes on permission shorthand; status swallows crash and prints false-green leak scan.
_debug_entry_rules iterates possibly-None permissions; TypeError silently degrades wrapper to project-file scan.
Export hardcodes agent user opencode; customized-user dumps silently chowned root:root, later imports fail.
handover residual check-then-act window between -L gate and chown -R; documented accepted residual.
sock_reachable uses sudo without -n unlike sibling probes; surprise password prompt possible.
Agents-migration prompt not ui_menu; Enter defaults to the destructive Move (rm -rf sources).
Advanced-mode default n silently skips deny-all bypass protection; protection depends on mode plus keypress.
Claim: unquoted advisories.sh heredoc enables expansion/injection; empirically verified non-recursive, rejected.

process_notes: e2e suites did NOT run at review time; lint and make test green; shell-semantics and API claims verified empirically incl. live GitHub API.
One candidate finding (heredoc injection) rejected as false positive during lead verification.
Extensive verified-clean list: install.sh lead review, templates, staged-write/sudoers-deploy, config.sh, tui, release.sh.
Overall assessment quoted: all six MEDs are internal inconsistencies (twin code paths diverging) or external-API boundary mismatches; no broken core mechanism.
